g.text: Post Acquisition Order Flow (Rate Plan Changes)
General flow for product or service add ons, exchanges, upsells, removals, downsells.
There is a separate flow for suspension, resumption, renewal and cancellation.
Details of payment gateway and tax integrations have been intentionaly excluded
for clarity. In this diagram 'Portal' is your web site or application running on
your server(s) where prospects or your sales team can view the customer's existing
subscription as well as sign up for your services and products. Your customer or
sales are sitting in front of 'Browser'.
Rate Plan to Add with Quantity
Since they are already a customer asking how to pay may not be required. This flow
assumes you invoice for any upsells immediately, our best practice. This isn't
required by Zuora, Zuora will bill them on their regular billing day using their default
payment method if runBilling is false on the order (the default).
How would you like to pay?
Send email confirming order, include $0 balance Invoice PDF as receipt
Send email confirming order, include Invoice PDF for payment
